title: Make It Responsive
prompt:
Turn a desktop-only page responsive:

- Base (mobile): `.cards` stacks as a single-column grid.
- At `min-width: 640px`: two columns. At `min-width: 1024px`: three columns.
- Give `img` (or the `.cards img`) fluid behavior: `max-width: 100%` and `height: auto`.
boilerplate:
Red car
Blue boat
Green train

tests.name: single column by default
tests.hint: Mobile-first: the base rule IS the phone layout — grid-template-columns: 1fr;

tests.name: two columns at 640px
three columns at 1024px
fluid images
tests.hint: img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; } — shrink, never stretch.
